parsed_response.reasoning: The diff adds minimumTokenResponseSchema in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts containing only access_token (plus odd computed keys), and callers like googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts and office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts now write the parsed result back via prisma.credential.update({data:{key: ...}}) where the previous code parsed the full credential schema (googleCredentialSchema/refreshTokenResponseSchema). Zod objects strip unknown keys by default, so under APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED the persisted key loses refresh_token and other fields (and the code even substitutes the literal string "refresh_token" when absent), permanently breaking the credential. The exact behavior depends on whether the malformed computed-key schema parses or throws, but either outcome (silent data loss or broken token refresh) is a real defect introduced by this diff; the core mechanism is verifiable in the diff.
